plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Transfer Pathway map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the first/default pathway, the Transfer Pathway to CSU Bakersfield, Bakersfield College portion ONLY (Terms 1-4). The same page's CSU Bakersfield continuation (Human Development and Family Studies - Bachelor of Arts, 60 units, Terms 9-12) is a different institution's degree and is excluded. The program's other pathway, 'Bakersfield College Early Childhood Education Associate in Science for Transfer' (also printed at 60-64 units, 4 terms), is a further pattern for the same AS-T credential, not a separate degree, and is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the Bakersfield College degree total as a range, 60-64 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-17.5 / 15 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. CHDV B42 is printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; it is a named major course and is recorded with category 'major'. Course titles are recorded exactly as printed, including 'Child Health. Safety, and Nutrition' (CHDV B49) and 'Observation & Assessmnt- Birth Through Adolescence' (CHDV B22). CHDV B41 shows a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; the map does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded and the flag is disclosed on that course row. No other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in the Bakersfield College section. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan.'
